name: FSD50K
description: Sound-event classification dataset with 200 AudioSet-ontology classes and about 51k audio clips. Per-clip Freesound terms apply; metadata is CC-BY. No data is vendored.
citation: Fonseca, E., Favory, X., Pons, J., Font, F., & Serra, X. (2022). FSD50K: An Open Dataset of Human-Labeled Sound Events. IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing.

license.identifier: Per-clip Freesound terms apply; licenses vary by clip and are not represented by one SPDX identifier. Metadata is CC-BY.
